name: dsmn
author: Nom de la Société
description: Keeps your Omarchy computer awake while a local coding agent is working, then lets it sleep when that work stops. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok, and Pi can keep a timer going from the bar. You can also start 30 minutes, 90 minutes, or a length you choose, up to 8 hours. Stop, or the end of the timer, allows sleep again. The screen can still blank and the session can still lock. Installing it does not add hooks or change sleep settings. Those stay in Settings, and only if you ask.

barWidget.description: Keeps the computer awake while an agent works, and shows the time left.
